title: Components
intro: A glossary of the parts that show up on the bikes in the portfolio.

items.name: Billy Bonkers
items.description: A fast-rolling 26 inch mountain bike tire with a low center tread, popular for turning old mountain bikes into city bikes.

items.name: Gravel King
items.description: A supple gravel tire that rolls well on pavement and handles light dirt.

items.name: Road Cruiser
items.description: A classic gumwall tire for city, touring and vintage road bikes.

items.name: LT riser
items.description: A low-rise alloy mountain bike bar with a comfortable sweep for everyday riding.

items.name: Forty
items.description: A sealed bearing headset that is a reliable upgrade for older frames.

items.name: GE1
items.description: An ergonomic grip with a wide wing that supports the palm and takes pressure off the hands on longer rides.

items.name: ESI
items.description: A soft silicone grip that is light and comfortable.

items.name: Moondust
items.description: A slim lock-on grip with a soft, tacky rubber compound.

items.name: Stamp 1
items.description: A flat platform pedal with replaceable pins for grip.

items.name: GRX
items.description: Shimano's gravel-specific components, built for rough roads and wide gearing.

items.name: Deore
items.description: Shimano's mid-level mountain bike line, durable with a wide gear range.

items.name: Deore XT
items.description: Shimano's long-running high-end mountain bike group, a step above Deore and prized for durability.
A step below Ultegra in the road line, well regarded for its shifting and value.

items.name: Narrow wide chainring
items.description: A single chainring with alternating tooth widths that holds the chain without a front derailleur or guide.

items.name: B17
items.description: A leather saddle that molds to the rider over time.

items.name: Service Course
items.description: A thin, tacky road bar tape.
